ways.label: Tama Lakes Track to Tama Saddle

via.name: junction with the Tongariro Northern Circuit Great Walk
via.quote: the junction with the Tongariro Northern Circuit Great Walk

evidence: Start this track from Whakapapa Village, on the Taranaki Falls Walking Track.
The track ends at a wide, flat clearing on Tama Saddle, with spectacular views of Lower Tama Lake, Mt Ngauruhoe and Mt Ruapehu.

side_trips.name: Upper Tama Lake viewpoint
side_trips.from: Tama Saddle (end of the Tama Lakes Track)

doubts: The start is given as Whakapapa Village (T11); the exact trailhead is on the Taranaki Falls Walking Track 100 m below the Visitor Centre on Ngauruhoe Place, but the two road end features are on Ngauruhoe Terrace and cannot be told apart, so no road end ref is given. Tama Saddle has no entry in the packet. DOC's time says '(to Lower Tama Lake)' though the text says there is no formed track down to the lakes; the end is taken as Tama Saddle where the text says the track ends. The Tongariro Northern Circuit junction is passed near the end but the circuit itself is another walk.
